annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions (Research report 2)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions (Research report 2)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Evidence Based Policing Centre, New Zealand Police
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand Police research report reviewing AI tools used in policing's corporate and enabling functions, such as documentation, audio/video analysis, data integration, biometrics, call management, community interaction and recruitment. It identifies challenges (accuracy, integration, privacy, internal trust) and recommends keeping a human in the loop and strengthening governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI tools improve efficiency in documentation, audio/video analysis, data integration and biometrics.
Performance inaccuracies stem from bias, poor data and lack of contextual understanding.
Keep a human in the loop with training and continuous oversight.
Ensure effective integration, governance and data architecture.
Address employee trust, deskilling and job-loss fears through open communication.
